narr: A mid-level area of high shifted east and decreased in amplitude which opened the door for increased moisture, a classical medium to high end monsoonal pattern.
ev: Heavy rain caused Oak Creek to rise 1.5 feet at the gauge in Sedona (OAKA3).

Heavy rain fell over the western part of the Pipeline Fire scar (June 2022). This caused Schultz Creek (Dry Lakes gauge) to jump 2.84 feet. This flowed over Mt Elden Road, overwhelmed the drainage system along Highway 180, and flooded apartments and homes along Stevanna Way.

Heavy rain over the Schultz Fire scar (2010), Tunnel Fire scar (April 2022), and Pipeline Fire scar (June 2022) caused flooding in the area below. The water transported mud, ash, and debris across roads and filled ditches.
